title: BNP Paribas Young Talent Team - Heads or Tails - Emma Jouy
description: In 2018, BNP Paribas launched the BNP Paribas Young Talents Team, in partnership with the French Tennis Federation (FFT). The support programme is intended to give 20 promising young French tennis talent the best possible chance of reaching the highest levels of competition and becoming the champions of tomorrow. The BNP Paribas Young Talent Team, mentored by tennis player Jo-Wilfried Tsonga, is part of the BNP Paribas Group's commitment policy towards today's youth. The young players in the programme will benefit in two ways: financial assistance to take part in their sport; human support to prepare them for the challenges of professional tennis (image management, English lessons, legal advice, planning ahead in case they eventually wish to switch careers, etc.).
